postal_system.assignment_rule: Office des Postes d’Haïti and the UPU define the integral postcode as HT plus four digits, including for domestic mail. The four digits encode department, arrondissement, commune and delivery area. A pinned operator result can establish a time-bound assignment; syntax, a UPU example, an IHSI code, locality name or synthetic fixture is not proof of a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reusable nationwide Office des Postes d’Haïti full-code postal-polygon release with confirmed redistribution terms is bundled or asserted. IHSI administrative divisions and CNIGS boundaries or reference geodata are not automatically postal delivery areas. They may support a separately labelled derived-review Polygon or MultiPolygon only after an explicit postcode crosswalk, source permission, edition, CRS, digest, topology and ambiguity review. Buffers, Voronoi cells, interpolation and ML surfaces remain derived review.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building, floor, unit, street, house number, neighborhood, communal section or quarter, commune, arrondissement, department, locality, post office, P.O. Box and integral HTNNNN postcode separately. UPU examples and synthetic fixtures are not production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as delivery_area, locality_assignment, route, post_office, po_box, organization, point, polygon, multipolygon, unknown or derived_review_surface. Hierarchical digits, an administrative polygon, centroid, buffer or model surface do not prove operator-authored postal geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identifier, a separately permitted building or footprint identifier and an explicit reviewed relation with source, validity, privacy, CRS and digest. Postcode containment, IHSI or CNIGS geography, a street number, parcel, point, coordinate or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: IHSI maintains a separate six-digit legal territorial code for department, arrondissement, commune and communal section, town or quarter. Preserve that code, edition and hierarchy independently; it is not the Office des Postes HTNNNN assignment even where names or boundaries align.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: A realtime operator lookup may validate a single observation only when request purpose, terms, rate policy, observed_at, response status and digest are retained; timeout, outage or empty response is not proof of no assignment. Release-pinned operator observations and rights-cleared IHSI, CNIGS and community context may validate joins, flag drift, prioritize review and compress geometry. Every model output records inputs, algorithm, generated_at, confidence and uncertainty and never invents an assignment, street, house number, unit, building, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate exact operator observations, independently sourced administrative context, explicitly linked civic addresses or buildings and derived review surfaces to AGID cells without relabelling AGID or administrative geometry as official Haitian postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Office des Postes lookup observations, UPU publications, IHSI publications, CNIGS resources and ODbL content retain separate terms and provenance partitions. Public visibility is not a bulk redistribution licence. Pin the exact resource, terms snapshot, permission or licence, attribution, edition, schema, CRS and SHA-256 digest before publishing data or geometry.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO HT scope and stores postal, political-administrative, statistical, cadastral, address, building and AGID representations independently. It does not resolve disputed boundaries, silently extend coverage or treat a geographic hierarchy as delivery entitlement.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, house numbers, units, coordinates, property relations, lookup queries, recipients, organizations, owners, occupants, credentials and logs can expose household, security or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; exclude private and owner-linked data from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Operator assignments, the UPU September 2017 sheet, IHSI territorial divisions and 2024 publication, CNIGS resources, derived surfaces, civic/building relations and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, resource version, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet, GeoParquet or PMTiles partitions with exact attribution, release, jurisdiction, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Real private addresses, query logs, restricted property data and credentials stay private, gated or external. Dataset Viewer is discovery, a Space is demonstration and production AGID readers pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
